Thanks to Webtoon for sponsoring this short. Start reading FOGLAND today: https://www.webtoons.com/en/action/fog-land/

FOGLAND is an engaging Webtoon comic that draws you into the mystery unfolding at Fogland prison. Not everything is as it seems and you can’t trust anyone, including the good guys. Oh, and remember to stay away from the fog…
